description: WMT26 local/offline model registry. Contains only planned WMT26 systems that mtoc can run on the local 8x80GB node. The default backend is 'auto': mtoc tries vLLM first (faster, handles quantized checkpoints like gpt-oss MXFP4) and transparently falls back to the HF/Transformers Accelerate path when vLLM does not support a model. Proprietary, external-provider, old exploratory, and multi-node-only systems are tracked in run_manifest.json instead.

qwen3_5_9b.notes: WMT26 sheet: Qwen 3.5 9B. Public HF id verified by API probe.

tiny_aya_global.notes: WMT26 sheet: Tiny Aya Global. HF id verified by API search; gated repo, requires approved access.

gemma4_e4b.notes: WMT26 sheet: Gemma 4 4B. HF search returned google/gemma-4-E4B-it; gated Google model.

ministral3_14b.notes: WMT26 sheet: Ministral 3 14B. HF backend upcasts the FP8 checkpoint to bf16 (no fine-grained FP8 kernels needed). Short inputs translate well; very long documents may need generation tuning.

gpt_oss_20b.notes: WMT26 sheet: GPT OSS 20B. Public HF id verified by API probe. Reasoning minimized (reasoning_effort=low) and only the Harmony 'final' channel is saved; max_new_tokens raised to 2048 so the answer is not cut off mid-analysis.

tower_9b.notes: WMT26 sheet: TowerPlus 9B. Strong translation-tuned chat model.

glm4_9b.notes: WMT26 sheet: GLM 4 9B. Runs on the HF backend with legacy chatglm remote-code compat shims (single-GPU load, KV cache disabled).

qwen3_6_27b.notes: WMT26 sheet: Qwen3.6-27B. Public HF id verified by API search.

gemma4_31b.notes: WMT26 sheet: Gemma 4 31B. HF search returned google/gemma-4-31B-it; gated Google model.

mistral_medium_3_5.notes: WMT26 sheet: Mistral Medium 3.5. Public HF id verified by API search; reserve all 8 GPUs until measured.

gpt_oss_120b.notes: WMT26 sheet: GPT OSS 120B. Public HF id verified by API probe; reserve all 8 GPUs. Runs on the vLLM backend (tensor_parallel_size=8): vLLM loads the native MXFP4 MoE weights, whereas the HF loader hits a CUDA illegal-memory-access materializing MXFP4 across GPUs. dtype=auto lets vLLM pick the compute dtype. Reasoning minimized (reasoning_effort=low) and only the Harmony 'final' channel is saved; max_new_tokens raised to 2048 so the answer is not cut off mid-analysis.
